content.short: AUTOfinance automates liquidity management, rebalancing LP positions across DeFi protocols.
content.description: AUTOfinance, formerly Tokemak, runs Autopools that monitor liquidity pools and lending markets and rebalance when yields or conditions shift. Allocation decisions weigh a full set of metrics instead of moving to whichever pool advertises the highest number. Returns are converted back into the Autopool's base asset and redeployed, leaving a depositor with one position in a single denomination. The protocol offers curated strategies across several chains and assets, each with its own risk profile, and has worked with external auditors since launch.
